grip_vampire.description: Vampire grip: collar-haul cloth whoosh, low hiss, bite = bat-wing burst + dark string sting, three slowing muffled heartbeats with ethereal shimmer, release, body settles, bats disperse, final heartbeat stops.

grip_ghoul.description: Ghoul grip: stone floor cracks, bone spikes clack/grind up, irregular guttural growl bed with four stone/gravel crunch lunges over a sickly drone, bone cage crumbles to dust and cracks grind shut.

grip_werewolf.description: Werewolf grip: formant snarl, heavy pounce pin, three claw swipes (air rip + metallic rake + dull thump), violent shaking growl, shockwave whoomp and a full rising/falling formant wolf howl with dust and reverb tail.

grip_wraith.description: Wraith grip: frost crackles spread with icy wind, cold palm thump + glass chime, rising detuned ghost-choir/whisper soul pull, spectral tearing yank into a silence gap, reverse-reverb swirl into the fist, cold pulse with frost shattering.

grip_priest.description: Priest grip: robe rustle kneel, bright holy choir cross with gold sparkle, a distorted ring-modulated demon voice fighting back with three spasm hits and ink-smoke hisses, then a huge church bell toll + flash + shockwave as the demon voice tears upward and burns out into embers; cathedral tail.

grip_human.description: Human grip: knee drop thud, silver glint shing as the stake appears, wooden creaks/grip tension struggle, raise whoosh, deep wooden THOCK with sub hit and a 60 ms hit-stop silence, ash/dust hiss drifting away.

grip_human_monster_ash.description: Monster-target layer for the human grip: pale whoosh, dry crumbling ash disintegration and a faint ghostly exhale.

grip_victim_heartbeat.description: Seamless 4.0 s loop for the victim's screen: muffled heavy heartbeat (75 bpm, 5 beats per loop) over a low dark drone that ducks with each beat.

grip_finish_sting.description: Generic dark low kill sting for the gripper's hit-stop: sub boom, low dissonant string cluster stab, dark metallic resonance.

sub_royal_bats_gold.description: Royal vampire extra: shimmering golden bat-wing burst with bright sparkle.

sub_alpha_double_shock.description: Alpha werewolf extra: two stacked shockwave whoomps with debris and dust.

sub_crypt_cage_tall.description: Crypt ghoul extra: bigger, deeper bone cage rise with deep grinding and a heavy top-out.

sub_hollow_frost_crown.description: Hollow wraith extra: crystalline frost crown forming - rising glass arpeggio converging into an eerie detuned glass chord.

sub_pope_twin_bell.description: Pope priest extra: two church bells a perfect fifth apart (A3 then E4) in a cathedral.

sub_super_crater.description: Super human extra: ground-crack crater impact with sub boom, shockwave and debris rain.
